name: @loom/experience-tabs-planner
description: loom-ui U15 (planner depth) on a support-ticket triage view (non-genUI): a ReferencePlanner with a scripted model composes ONE `tabs` container (Overview / Queue / History) offered via REFERENCE_CONTAINER_ROLES, every planner container stamped owner "planner"; renderBlueprintDom({ containers: referenceContainers() }) draws a real tablist (aria wiring, roving tabindex, keyboard switch keeps focus) and the terminal stacks every panel; a revise is a minimal diff (one moveNode + the inserts of a new tab, no recompose) while an application-owned container stays locked; one setRole turns the tabs into a stepper; a panel whose cards are all bound to a `secret` capability collapses to a bare placeholder for a low-clearance viewer (policy A) and Lineage.explain answers {available:false}.
